## 4c318aba383e

**Reproduced shortcut undercoverage inside the validator-accepted domain.** In
3,000 default samples (1,000 per band), every non-marker top/left border cell was
zero. A shortcut that uses the *first nonzero* top/left border position instead
of locating color 2 therefore fits all generated inputs. All four canonical
pairs contain nonzero border distractors, and the current `self_check` rejects
each canonical input solely because it requires `(0,0) == 0` while canonicals
use 7 there.

The saved 5×5 counterexample passes `self_check`, places distractors at border
position 1 and the true color-2 markers at position 3, and makes the shortcut
return the unshifted interior. Racket returns a two-row/two-column circular
shift, so the outputs disagree. Exact input, rival output, Racket output,
generator/rule hashes, census, and command are in
`checks/audit/4c318aba383e/counterexample.json` and
`checks/audit/4c318aba383e/racket.json`. No audit-target source was changed.

triage.reason: Both adversarial findings, source-bound reproducers and notes retained; unrelated audit targets unchanged.
